dog.description_text:
Meet Projector (aka Grover), possibly the best and easiest dog around! He settled into his foster home right away and is the chillest, sweetest pup you’ll meet. He’s happy being a couch potato, and he loves getting outside for a good round of zoomies at the park. His favorite thing of all is climbing into your lap and melting in your arms.

Projector is a polite, goofy little boy with great manners. He’s house trained and crate trained, walks on a nice loose leash, sits when you put his leash on, and even has recall! He’s friendly with dogs of all sizes and all kinds of people. He’s easy to bathe and groom, nail trims included. While his humans are at work, he’s content munching on snacks and chew bones 🦴.

If you would like to adopt this Rockstar, please visit www.pupstarzrescue.org for an application!
